'''Skeletons''' in Daemonheim can only be found in the Abandoned, Occult, and Warped floors. As they are melee fighters, they are considerably weak against magic attacks. They often wield weapons such as [[Hatchets|Hatchet]]s, [[Warhammer]]s, [[Longsword]]s, and more. On occasion, they can drop these weapons when defeated.

==Drops==
===100%===
{{DropsTableHead}}
{{DropsLine|name=Bones (Dungeoneering)|quantity=1|rarity=Always|gemw=no}}
{{DropsTableBottom}}

===Weapons===
The type of weapon dropped depends on the skeleton's combat level and the weapon type it is wielding. For example, a promethium hatchet can only be dropped by a level 126 skeleton wielding a hatchet.
